name: shelf
label: Shelf
tagline: Keep articles to read later, offline

help.about: Paste an article's address and Shelf keeps its text and pictures to read later, offline, with full-text search.

manifest.summary: Read-later over trafilatura: paste an address (or use the bookmarklet) and Shelf keeps the article's text and pictures in its own folder, readable offline. Full-text search (SQLite FTS5), unread/all/archived, a bin that uses the desktop trash, and 'Research in Dossier' (send_to in shelf.json is the registry). Fetches only public addresses.
